summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing positive preliminary economic assessment (PEA) results for its São Jorge Project in Brazil. The PEA reports after-tax NPV of $532M and IRR of 42.4% at $3,500/oz gold, with initial capital of $202M. No transaction, activist, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a routine project update, not a special situation.
